module.name: settings-account
module.title: Account settings
module.description: Renders the signed-in user's account settings tab, including the hosted Clerk user-portal link and the danger-zone entry point.

en.settings.account_clerk_managed: Profile, password, social connections, and two-factor authentication are managed by Clerk.
en.settings.account_deleted: Your account has been deleted. Goodbye!
en.settings.appearance_body: Saved to your account, so these follow you to every device — and the digest email speaks your language.
en.settings.danger_blocked: Transfer the admin role in %s first — you're the only admin.
en.settings.danger_body: Permanently delete your account. Organizations where you are the only member are deleted too; audit rows are kept.
en.settings.danger_confirm_label: Type your email address to confirm
en.settings.danger_confirm_prompt: Permanently delete this account? This cannot be undone.
en.settings.danger_mismatch: That doesn't match your account email.
en.settings.data_body: Download everything we hold about your account as JSON — profile, memberships, notifications, and audit trail.

es.settings.account_clerk_managed: El perfil, la contraseña, las conexiones sociales y la autenticación de dos factores se gestionan en Clerk.
es.settings.account_deleted: Tu cuenta ha sido eliminada. ¡Hasta pronto!
es.settings.appearance_body: Se guarda en tu cuenta, así te acompaña en todos tus dispositivos y el correo de resumen habla tu idioma.
es.settings.danger_blocked: Transfiere primero el rol de administrador en %s: eres el único administrador.
es.settings.danger_body: Elimina tu cuenta permanentemente. Las organizaciones en las que eres el único miembro también se eliminan; el registro de auditoría se conserva.
es.settings.danger_confirm_label: Escribe tu correo electrónico para confirmar
es.settings.danger_confirm_prompt: ¿Eliminar esta cuenta permanentemente? No se puede deshacer.
es.settings.danger_mismatch: No coincide con el correo de tu cuenta.
es.settings.data_body: Descarga en JSON todo lo que guardamos sobre tu cuenta: perfil, membresías, notificaciones y registro de actividad.
